stages.name: A
stages.prompt: The docs site needs better text helpers. Add four helpers to textutil, each with table-driven tests: Slugify (lowercase, runs of spaces and punctuation become one hyphen, no leading or trailing hyphens), Truncate(s string, n int) (keep n runes, append an ellipsis when it cut), Title (capitalize each word), and Wrap(s string, width int) []string (wrap on word boundaries). Then run go vet.
